summary: Read the retained receipt for the VerifyLeader experiment (CheckRun df528a8a25a04cbd9fb1cc12319f3467, exit 0): parsed events 2/5/8 show the partitioned leader, whose quorum is 2 of three voters with one non-voter, answering VerifyLeader with nil while only the demoted non-voter is reachable (leader_state Leader, elapsed 0ms); controls 11 and 14 end in 'leadership lost while committing log'. The declared comparisons were reported incomplete because each admission alias only reached its own case's setup events, so the other cases counted as missing instead of outside applicability. Submitted a declared successor (previous_id = 101498ecfbb945e0b48676dd9e9f4172-experiment) that adds per-case applicability conditions to the three comparisons and otherwise reuses the same harness, prefix, scope, requirement and sources; the fresh execution is required by that applicability change. The open gap about whether the false confirmation can outlive the leader's lease window remains to be investigated with a per-node-timing harness.
